hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'git push' && { git log --oneline origin/$(git branch --show-current)..HEAD 2>/dev/null; echo; git diff origin/$(git branch --show-current)..HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -300; } | claude -p "You are a code reviewer. Review these git changes about to be pushed. Be concise — list only actual bugs, security issues, or breaking changes in bullet points. If nothing serious, say 'Looks good to push.'" || true
